All 317 tests pass and no upstream files were modified. Let me update the handoff notes.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# HANDOFF — cachetools tagged cache (milestone 3 complete)

## Status: R01-R08 implemented in src/cachetools/tagged.py
- R01-R03: put/get deep-copy detachment, tag normalization (finite iterable of
  strings, bare string/bytes rejected, nonstring entries rejected, dedup, single
  consumption pass), invalidate(), LRU recency on put/get, one slot per value,
  maxsize positive int (bool excluded). Invalid replacement input never mutates
  state (tags/ttl validated up front).
- R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all'); empty requested tags -> 0;
  invalid mode/tags raise ValueError before mutation.
- R05: resize(maxsize) validates first; shrink evicts LRU via _TaggedLRUCache
  (records evicted keys to prune tag memberships/expiry); grow never evicts;
  survivors keep values/tags/LRU order/absolute expiry; maxsize property.
- R06: generator tags consumed once; deep copies detached across gets/puts.
- R07: TaggedCache(maxsize, timer=None) default time.monotonic; put(..., ttl=None);
  ttl None = immortal; finite nonnegative int/float (bool excluded) -> expiry
  timer()+ttl; invalid ttl (neg, bool, nan, inf, non-number) ValueError before
  mutation; ttl=0 immediately expired; expiry boundary (now >= expiry) expired.
- R08: __purge_expired() runs before get/put/len/resize/invalidate/invalidate_many/
  pop; purge uses del (no recency touch on survivors); overwrite replaces prior
  expiry; invalidation counts only live entries; expired/missing get -> KeyError.

## Design notes
- _TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache) records evicted keys in _evicted; _resize mutates
  _Cache__maxsize directly and pops LRU items. Expiry stored in TaggedCache
  (not in values) so resize preserves absolute expiry (round-2 clarification).
- Timer only consulted when expiry state exists; failing timer -> no expiry.
- Superseded old design note ('empty all-tags matches every key / resize may
  flush') is WRONG per R04/R05 — do not follow it.

## Verification (run with PYTHONPATH=src:.)
- python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q  -> 317 passed
  (313 upstream + 4 public incl. test_public_ttl)
- Extra TTL tests in /tmp/test_ttl_extra.py (20 tests) also pass; kept out of
  tests/ to avoid touching upstream test suite. Coverage: boundary expiry,
  ttl=0, invalid ttl before mutation, overwrite expiry replace, purge before
  len/put/resize/invalidate without recency touch, resize preserves absolute
  expiry, tag cleanup after expiry, key reuse after expiry.
EOF
echo done"}
